frontier.hypothesis: A zero-instruction CODE_LABEL placed between block 0's `i = a0` and block 0's `a0 << 4` splits the EBB at BOTH cse passes, so the shift keeps the parameter pseudo (target's $s2) while the loop-1 guard and the loop-2 preheader keep the counter pseudo ($s0) — closing the last instruction.
frontier.mechanism: cse.c:8039 terminates an extended basic block at any CODE_LABEL irrespective of LABEL_NUSES and irrespective of after_loop, so unlike the NOTE_INSN_LOOP_END device (killed this session at cse.c:8055) a label survives cse2. The obstacle is jump.c: jump_optimize deletes a jump whose target is the next insn and then deletes the label once LABEL_NUSES hits zero, in the same pass, and the dead-goto label-pad spelling is a FORBIDDEN family, so the label must be one an ordinary construct genuinely needs.
frontier.next_probe: Read tools/gcc-2.7.2/jump.c's label and jump deletion predicates end to end and enumerate ordinary-C constructs that leave a surviving CODE_LABEL with no emitted instruction. Concrete candidates to build and measure: a one-case switch around the copy; a do { ... } while (cond) whose exit label is referenced by a break that jump.c cannot fold to a jump-to-next; and any restructuring that puts loop 1's own top label between the copy and the shift while the shift still lands before the guard branch. For each form, check dumps/text1a_c.cse2 for `(ashift:SI (reg/v:SI 72)` in block 0 BEFORE reading the score, and reject anything at build_insns != 83.

frontier.hypothesis: cse2's crown can be flipped to the parameter pseudo without touching cse1, because toplev.c:2925 re-runs reg_scan on the POST-LOOP RTL, so cse2's global clause (B) is evaluated on last-use positions loop.c may have moved.
frontier.mechanism: If loop.c's strength reduction or biv elimination makes loop 2's counter (reg 75) die before the pointer pseudo (reg 72), then uid_cuid[regno_last_uid[75]] < uid_cuid[regno_last_uid[72]] at cse2 and make_regs_eqv (cse.c:854-856) leaves reg 72 canonical, so block 0's shift keeps the parameter. The cost is that the loop-2 preheader shift then flips the wrong way, so this is only worth measuring in combination with a cse1-side split (frontier 1) that protects the preheader.
frontier.next_probe: Compare regno_last_uid for regs 72 and 75 between dumps/text1a_c.loop and dumps/text1a_c.cse2 on candidate.c, then measure loop-2 shapes that push reg 75's last use earlier (pointer-compare exit test; idx merged into the pointer so only two inductions remain), each with `sandbox func_80045294 --disable all` at build_insns == 83.

frontier.hypothesis: The block-0 prologue cluster has a free 3-insn scheduling degree of freedom that can pay back the rotation any successful idx-9 fix might cost.
